description: Decentralized, zero-knowledge encrypted version control for confidential files with multi-operator storage, P2P discovery, and Arbitrum L2 anchoring.
notes: To initialize a vault in your repository: ciphervault init
To track confidential files: ciphervault track .env
To inspect encrypted secret diffs: ciphervault diff
To run commands with zero-disk secrets: ciphervault run -- <command>
To launch the web dashboard: ciphervault ui
